interpretation.countsUnit: Per configuration default complete target. Repeated versions/modules are not independent objects. A target connection does not establish that every derived question tests it.
interpretation.motionScope: Existing benchmark actions attach/detach one rigid piece using qualified straight paths. No connected articulation action, elastic snap-fit, force/deformation, or unrestricted curved insertion is certified.
